tables.title: Summary of device limitations
tables.text_helper: Table 3, "Summary of device limitations", on page 2 of Rev 4 in section 1 (Summary of device errata).

rows: HSI48 clock fails to stop upon entering Stop mode
PA11 Schmitt trigger remains effective in analog input mode
Missed wakeup event coinciding with Stop entry
A non-zero HSIDIV[2:0] upon Stop entry may lead to a deadlock
First SRAM access after reset fails
PC14 cannot be used for HSE external clock on 48-pin packages
PB0/1/2/10 does not support negative injection
DMA disable failure and error flag omission upon simultaneous transfer error and global flag clear
SOFx not asserted when writing into DMAMUX_CFR register
OFx not asserted for trigger event coinciding with last DMAMUX request
OFx not asserted when writing into DMAMUX_RGCFR register
Wrong input DMA request routed upon specific DMAMUX_CxCR register write coinciding with synchronization event
Overrun flag is not set if EOC reset coincides with new conversion end
One-pulse mode trigger not detected in master-slave reset + trigger configuration
Consecutive compare event missed in specific conditions
Output compare clear not working with external counter reset
Calendar initialization may fail in case of consecutive INIT mode entry
Alarm flag may be repeatedly set when the core is stopped in debug
Loss of RTC calendar and configuration content upon system reset
Wrong data sampling when data setup time (t) is shorter than one SU;DAT I2C kernel clock period
Spurious bus error detection in master mode
OVR flag not set in underrun condition
Transmission stalled after first byte transfer
SDA held low upon SMBus timeout expiry in slave mode
Anticipated end-of-transmission signaling in SPI slave mode
Data corruption due to noisy receive line
Received data may be corrupted upon clearing the ABREN bit
Noise error flag set while ONEBIT is set
BSY bit may stay high when SPI is disabled
BSY bit may stay high at the end of data transfer in slave mode
table_content.legend: A = limitation present, workaround available / N = limitation present, no workaround available / P = limitation present, partial workaround available

tables.title: Document revision history
tables.text_helper: Table 4, "Document revision history", on page 15 of Rev 4.

rows: Added Z device version and updated Table 2. Device variants and Table 3. Summary of device limitations Added errata: •System: PB0/1/2/10 does not support negative injection •PC13 signal transitions disturb LSE Added Section Important security notice and information on core errata on Arm website. Removed errata (unduly inserted in the initial release): •ADC: Writing ADC_CFGR1 register while ADEN bit is set resets RES[1:0] bitfield •Out-of-threshold value is not detected in AWD1 Single mode •I2C: Spurious master transfer upon own slave address match •USART: USART prescaler feature missing in USART implementation section
First public release. Added erratum SDA held low upon SMBus timeout expiry in slave mode and updated Table 3. Summary of device limitations.

Added errata: •RTC: Loss of RTC calendar and configuration content upon system reset •I2C: OVR flag not set in underrun condition •Transmission stalled after first byte transfer •USART: Anticipated end-of-transmission signaling in SPI slave mode •Received data may be corrupted upon clearing the ABREN bit •Noise error flag set while ONEBIT is set Removed erratum REFCKON write protection associated to INIT KEY instead of CAL KEY.
